descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses the light three levels down and the dungeon closes in — wrong turns, sprung traps, something large keeping pace in the dark. The retreat is a running fight up stairs {worker_name} doesn't remember descending, and the surface is reached empty-handed and bleeding.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} clears the upper halls competently — a few skirmishes won, the obvious pressure plates stepped around — but the sounds rising from the lower stairwell argue persuasively against heroics. Minor loot, whole skin, and the long walk home spent rehearsing how to phrase it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} goes down floor by floor and comes back up the same way, which is the entire trick. Guardians put down, traps read before they trigger, and saddlebags of grave-gold and old steel set on the guild clerk's counter.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} bottoms out the dungeon — the actual bottom, the chamber the guild maps mark with a question. Whatever kept every previous party above the third floor is dead or outwitted, and the haul takes two trips to carry. The guild redraws the map and puts {worker_name}'s name on it.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s display of {trait} proves decisive.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s decisive {trait} turns the tide of battle.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} stumbles upon something far beyond their capabilities - an ancient guardian, a cursed entity, or forces of nature that should not be trifled with. The encounter is brief and terrifying - a desperate flight for survival leaves them shaken and wounded, but alive. The experience serves as a harsh reminder of the true dangers that lurk in the wilds.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} encounters unexpected danger of legendary proportions. Through quick thinking and a fighting retreat, manages to escape with their life and minor wounds. Whatever they faced was overwhelming, but survival itself is a victory worth celebrating.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} faces an unexpected encounter with forces far beyond normal threats. Through skill and determination, manages to overcome or escape the danger, driving it away or securing a tactical victory. They return with proof of the encounter and valuable materials recovered from the confrontation.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} survives an encounter with a legendary enemy that would have killed most adventurers. Through exceptional skill and courage, not only survives but gains the upper hand against overwhelming odds, forcing the legendary enemy to retreat. They return with rare trophies and a tale that will be remembered for generations.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s decisive {trait} turns the tide of battle.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s careful {trait} shows in every page of notes.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} spends hours chasing rumors and bad ledgers. The notes contradict each other, key details stay missing, and the guild clerk sends the stack back with a tired sigh. Little of it will help anyone in the field.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} pulls together a workable sketch of the creature: habits, a few sightings, and one solid warning. It is not brilliant work, but it is honest, and it fills gaps the job board did not mention.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} builds a clear brief from bestiaries, witness accounts, and recent contracts. Tracks, feeding patterns, and local names line up into something a party can actually use without guessing in the dark.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turns scattered gossip into a dossier the guild quietly copies. Rare behaviors, likely lairs, and market prices for parts are laid out so cleanly that even veterans pause to read it twice.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s careful {trait} shows in every page of notes.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help the archive shift today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} charges into the wilderness looking for anything — monster, bandit, brawl — to burn off the ache.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} fights with reckless abandon, throwing themselves at every threat without regard for safety. The distraction proves nearly fatal — a wolf pack exploit the careless openings and {worker_name} barely escapes, bloodied, bruised, and still burning.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} hacks through undergrowth and lesser beasts in a frustrated blur. The hunt is sloppy — overkill on a boar, a missed trap, wrong turns. The bounty is small and the pent-up energy barely dented.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} turns restless aggression into terrifying efficiency. Every swing lands harder than it needs to, every sprint covers ground faster than expected. The monster drops fast and the long walk back finally cools the blood. A decent bounty and aching muscles — both welcome.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} fights like something feral let off its chain. The target never stood a chance — {worker_name} is faster, meaner, and utterly relentless. The kill is clean, the loot is rich, and by the time they drag the carcass home, the heat has burned down to a manageable ember. The guild posts the hunt on the legends board.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns frustration into a legendary hunt.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} made the reckless charge even more dangerous.

professions.name: Treasure Hunter
professions.description: Explores abandoned tombs and temples in search of valuable treasures. Relies on agility and careful movement to navigate traps and slip past danger. Lower risk than adventuring but still rewarding.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} proves invaluable in navigating the ancient tomb.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} gets the third pressure plate wrong and spends the rest of the visit learning what the tomb's architect thought of visitors. Darts, a dropped ceiling, a corridor slowly filling with sand — the tomb keeps its dead and its gold, and {worker_name} keeps the bruises.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} reads the antechamber correctly and works two rooms with slow, careful hands, but the inner door's counterweights are beyond untangling in a single visit. The take is grave-goods from the servants' niches — honest coin, nothing storied.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} walks the tomb in a way its builders never intended — plates weighted with sandbags, dart tracks chalked, the sarcophagus lid levered up without waking anything. The burial hoard comes out in ordered bundles, catalogued before the dust settles.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} finds what the tomb was actually built to hide — a masons' seam behind the sarcophagus, and past it a second burial richer than the first. Every trap along the way is disarmed so cleanly the mechanisms could be reset. Hunters buy {worker_name} drinks for a month just to hear the sequence.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} proves invaluable in navigating the ancient tomb.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps uncover hidden treasures in the temple.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} misjudges the temple's wards and the temple takes it personally. Sigils flare, a stone guardian unfolds from its alcove, and the sprint back through the nave leaves no time to grab so much as a candlestick. The gods keep their silver.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} slips the outer wards and works the side chapels, but the sanctum's guardians never break their circuit and never offer an opening. A satchel of votive offerings is real profit — it just isn't the altar gold.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} treats the temple like a conversation — reading the wards, stepping only where the geometry permits, waiting out each guardian's patrol before crossing. The sanctum opens without a spark, and the relics come away clean.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} does what the guild's oldest hands call impossible: crosses the entire sanctum without waking a single sigil and lifts the altar reliquary from under a guardian's gaze. The temple never learns it was robbed. Collectors bid on the relics; other hunters bid on the route.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps uncover hidden treasures in the temple.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} reveals the crypt's greatest secrets.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} finds the crypt, which turns out to be the easy part. The entry gallery's puzzle-lock jams on a mistake, the dark comes down close and airless, and the way out costs every candle carried in. The discovery is real — the profit now belongs to whoever tries next.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} maps the first galleries and cracks two of the lesser locks — solid, patient work. But the deep vault's mechanism wants tools nobody thought to bring, so the trip pays out in burial trinkets and a very valuable sketch of what still waits below.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} works the crypt lock by lock, gallery by gallery, chalking each row of the dead to keep the map honest. The vault at the bottom gives up coffers untouched since the sealing, and the site goes into the guild registry under {worker_name}'s claim.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} doesn't just open the crypt — {worker_name} understands it. The locks follow the funeral liturgy carved over the door; solved in that order, every gallery opens as if expected. The lowest vault holds the founder's hoard, intact and inventoried by morning. The guild names the site after its discoverer.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} reveals the crypt's greatest secrets.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in tools that actually fit the job.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} leaves a pry bar wrong, a line frayed, or a lamp badly seated. The mistake is small on a bench and huge in a dark corridor.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} replaces what was worn and oils what was sticking. The kit returns to baseline—no miracles, no surprises.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} sets up a trap-kit that feels unfairly calm: picks seat true, cordage runs clean, and backups sit where panic will not have to search.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} builds a setup other hunters borrow without asking. Every piece has a reason, every repair has a story, and the whole pack looks ready for stone that bites back.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in tools that actually fit the job.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help at the bench today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} tears into the ruins with reckless urgency — checking traps feels like a waste of time when the blood is running this hot.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} skips the usual trap checks and charges straight into a burial chamber. A pressure plate triggers a volley of poisoned darts, and the desperate scramble to escape brings down a section of ceiling. Crawls out empty-handed, bleeding, and still burning.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} rushes through corridors that deserve patience, jimmying locks with shaking hands and rifling through chests without cataloguing. A few trinkets are recovered, but a sealed vault is missed entirely because the impatient search pattern skipped the hidden passage.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} channels feverish energy into relentless, focused excavation. Tunnels that would take a day are cleared in hours, traps are disarmed with aggressive efficiency, and an overlooked side chamber yields a cache of old coins. The impatience, for once, pays off.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} tears through the ruin like a force of nature. The frantic pace somehow puts them one step ahead of every trap, and the instinct-driven search pattern leads straight to the main treasure vault. A haul that would take a careful team a week is dragged home in a single feverish day. The guild appraiser's eyes widen.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns reckless urgency into treasure-finding instinct.

professions.name: Boss Hunting
professions.description: Hunts legendary mythical beasts. Extreme risk with the highest rewards. Can obtain rare loot and legendary materials. Very dangerous.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s legendary {trait} proves essential in the hunt.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} finds the beast and picks the wrong ground to fight it on: open, no cover, a river at their back. The first exchange goes badly and the second goes worse. They come home carried, with nothing to show for it but the wounds and the map.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} drives the beast off after a long, ugly fight in failing light. It is wounded; so are they. What comes back is a sack of broken scale and a single horn, which the guild values honestly and low. The thing is still out there.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} spends the whole morning reading the ground before spending twenty minutes fighting on it — a narrow gully, a prepared fall, and a spear set where the beast has to come to it. They bring back the head, the hide and both horns, and the guild pays for all three.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} takes the beast without a serious wound, which nobody at the guild quite believes until the carcass arrives. Every part worth taking comes back intact and correctly cut: scale in sheets, horn unsplit, and the organs the alchemists pay stupid money for still cold. The story improves each time it is told, and it started well.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s legendary {trait} proves essential in the hunt.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} keeps the approach honest and the exit real.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} misreads the ground and pays for it in scrapes, lost time, and a route that ends where pride hoped it would not. The notes are more warning than help.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} maps the approach well enough to stop stupid mistakes. Peaks, washes, and blind corners are marked in plain ink—useful, unromantic, done.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} returns with lines that respect gravity and weather. The approach reads like someone planned to run it twice—once to learn, once to survive.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} charts a path that feels unfairly clean: cover, timing, and retreat slots where panic will not have to invent them. Even cynics bookmark the page.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} keeps the approach honest and the exit real.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help the recon today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} picks the most dangerous contract on the board — the kind nobody sane takes alone — and sets out before dawn with a grin that worries the quartermaster.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} charges the legendary beast head-on, ignoring every tactical opening. The creature barely has to try — a single swipe sends {worker_name} tumbling down a ravine. Crawling back to the guild battered and empty-handed, the healers mutter about a death wish.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} fights with reckless fury that occasionally connects. The beast takes wounds but refuses to fall, and {worker_name}'s stamina burns out before the kill. A tactical retreat with minor trophies — a fang, a patch of hide — but the bounty goes unclaimed.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} throws everything at the beast with a ferocity that catches it off guard. The usual caution is replaced by relentless aggression that, against all reason, works. The monster falls hard and fast. {worker_name} drags the carcass home drenched in blood and finally, blessedly calm.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} fights like something out of legend — a blur of steel and primal rage that the beast simply cannot match. The kill is savage, efficient, and terrifyingly beautiful. The guild master pins the contract receipt to the wall of fame, and the bounty is the largest payout of the season.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns suicidal bravery into a legendary kill.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} made the reckless charge nearly fatal.

professions.name: Monster Taming
professions.description: Captures and tames wild monsters to recruit them as workers. Can use combat prowess to subdue creatures through force, or seductive charm to lure them through primal attraction. High risk profession that expands your workforce with unique monster servants.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the capture particularly effective.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} springs the rig early and the creature goes straight through it. Two of the team come back with claw wounds and the netting is a write-off. Nothing for the guild but a healer's bill and a story nobody wants told twice.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} tracks the thing all day without ever getting a clean shot at a capture. What comes back is a good map of its range, a cast of its print, and a workable plan for next time. The guild pays the survey rate, which is not the rate it wanted to pay.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} runs a clean, disciplined hunt, wearing down a wild creature with skill and nerve. A strong day's work that pushes the guild's monster program forward and leaves the team poised to haul something home when the chance comes.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} pulls off a textbook operation - reading the beast, springing the rig, and pinning it without a scratch on the team. The kind of flawless hunt tamers retell for years, and exactly the sort of day a fearsome catch could be dragged back in chains.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the capture particularly effective.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes them utterly mesmerizing to the wild creature.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} goes out to lure a creature down with a display, and does it far too well. What comes is not calmed by any of it, and he is in no position to argue the point. It takes what it came for and goes back into the trees. He walks home bruised, short a cloak, and unwilling to make a report of it.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} finds a suitable monster and begins the display — slow movements, bare skin, scent on the air. The creature comes close, sniffing, plainly interested and plainly still wild. It circles him twice with obvious want and then wanders off, the seduction left unfinished.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} locates a territorial werewolf and dances for it. The beast's rage turns to fascination as he strips down by degrees, never quite close enough to touch. By keeping the want unmet he keeps the creature circling, hungry and pliant, following him step for step in the hope of more.
descriptions.critical_success: A dragon-kin finds {worker_name} halfway through an old fertility dance in its own lair, and forgets entirely what it came in to do. He works it to the edge of madness on promises alone, gives it nothing, and leaves it trembling and desperate — pliable to anyone who can keep that craving alive.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes them utterly mesmerizing to the wild creature.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes them utterly mesmerizing to the wild creature.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} goes out to draw a creature down with a display and gets all of the attention and none of the docility. It has no interest in being tamed and it is a great deal stronger than she is. It takes what it came for and is gone into the trees before she is back on her feet. No servant, and nothing she is willing to say at the guild about the bruises.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} picks out a lone bogwyrm and works the whole display on it: slow movement, bare skin, the scent carried downwind. It comes close enough that she can hear it breathing and stays there a long moment, undecided. Then something shifts in the reeds and the moment goes with it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} finds a hill troll sunning itself and gives it something better to look at. The wrappings come off one at a time, always a little further away than it wants her, and by the third the animal has stopped being territorial about anything at all. It follows her down to the treeline and would have followed her further.
descriptions.critical_success: A basilisk-kin catches {worker_name} halfway through the old dance in its own nest and never thinks to look at her properly, which is the only reason she walks out of it. She holds it at the edge of its own patience for an hour and gives it nothing, and leaves it wound tight enough that anyone who knows what to promise it now owns it.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes them utterly mesmerizing to the wild creature.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in knots, gates, and doses measured twice.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} leaves a latch stiff, a line uneven, or a dose sloppy. The rig looks ready until stress proves it is not, and the guild sends it back to the bench.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} brings the rig back to honest function. Nothing sings, nothing snaps, and the next attempt starts without a stupid handicap.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} builds capture gear that respects teeth, claws, and panic. Everything releases clean, everything tightens on purpose, and the work reads like patience with tools.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} assembles a setup other tamers copy without shame: clever tension, redundant safety, and small touches that keep blood off the contract line.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in knots, gates, and doses measured twice.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help the rig work today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} radiates a feral, restless energy that the creatures in the pen can smell — it either draws them closer or drives them wild.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name}'s pheromone-drenched approach confuses a territorial drake into a mating display that ends with {worker_name} pinned under three hundred pounds of amorous scales. The handlers have to pry them apart, and the creature is more agitated than before. No taming today.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} gets close enough to a wild beast to begin the bonding ritual, but the restless energy makes the movements too jerky, too unpredictable. The creature circles warily, occasionally nuzzling before snapping and retreating. Half-tamed at best — it'll need another session.
descriptions.success: {worker_name}'s primal energy resonates with the creature on an instinctive level. The beast approaches without fear, drawn by something it recognises in {worker_name}'s scent and body language. The bonding clicks into place faster than anyone expected, and the beast works through the full handling routine without panic. A flawless taming session that brings a future capture much closer.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} walks into the wild den radiating such raw, animalistic authority that the target creature simply... submits. No fight, no chase, no sedative. It trails {worker_name} around the den like it has waited its whole life for someone who speaks its language, calm and pliant through every drill. The handlers watch in stunned silence. The pens have never been this close to a real bond.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} creates a primal connection the creature can't resist.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} sent the wrong signal to the beast.

professions.name: Manager
professions.description: Helps manage the business operations. Each manager reduces the chance of daily events by 10%, stacking across all your buildings.

daily_stories.trait_success: The guild benefits from {worker_name}'s {trait} management.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses control of the guild's contract board. Jobs get double-booked, a party is sent out with the wrong brief, and both adventurers and clients leave angry.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} handles the guild's routine business without flair. Contracts get posted and fees collected, but nothing draws new adventurers through the door.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} keeps the guild's business in good order. Contracts are matched to capable parties, paperwork is filed on time, and clients get results without complaint.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} matches every contract to the perfect party, talks demanding clients into bonus terms, and gets three overdue expeditions back on schedule. Adventurers brag about the guild in every tavern in the district.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The guild benefits from {worker_name}'s {trait} management.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} can't concentrate on the fine print — signs contracts with shaking hands and approves expeditions without proper risk assessment.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} accepts a contract from a suspiciously generous client without reading the kill clause. The guild sends a team into a nest that turns out to be three times the reported size. Casualties, compensation claims, and a furious guild master. {worker_name} spends the evening being yelled at instead of doing anything about the ache.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} processes contracts at double speed to get away from the desk, skimming where they should study. A few unfavourable terms slip through — lower bounties, higher liability — nothing ruinous, but the adventurers grumble when they see the fine print.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} turns restless energy into ruthless contract negotiation. Too wired to be patient, but too sharp to be careless — every clause is challenged, every bounty pushed higher, every risk properly assessed. Clients leave feeling slightly fleeced, and the guild's cut is the best it's been all month.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} negotiates like someone possessed. A merchant guild that came in expecting to lowball the adventurers leaves having agreed to premium rates, exclusive supply contracts, and a retainer that covers three months of guild expenses. The adventurers toast {worker_name}'s name at the tavern that evening.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns impatience into aggressive deal-making.

professions.name: Rest
professions.description: Worker takes a break to regenerate health and energy. No daily events occur, allowing recovery without risk.

daily_stories.description: The worker takes a break in the guild break room, regenerating health and energy without a roll.

{worker_name} waits for the bunkroom to empty on the rest day and masturbates the restlessness out, biting down on the finish from habit. The climax burns off the edge that had been creeping into their aim.

building_types.name: Tavern
building_types.skill_description: Luxurious furnishings, comfortable beds, and welcoming atmospheres that make guests feel at home. Enhanced accommodations help your innkeepers handle difficult guests and create memorable experiences. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

professions.name: Bartender
professions.description: Serves drinks and tends the bar. Generates steady income through beverage service. Keeps customers happy and coming back.

daily_stories.trait_success: The client is delighted by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} pours three orders wrong in the first hour and lets an argument at the far end run until it reaches the tables. Two regulars settle up early. The barrel is tapped badly and half of it is flat by closing.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} keeps the drinks coming and the glasses clean. Orders are right, change is right, and nobody stays for the extra round they might have stayed for. The takings match a quiet Tuesday.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} has the regulars' drinks poured before they reach the bar and keeps the loud table talking to the room rather than at it. When the fiddler starts up the pace behind the bar doubles and still nobody waits. People stay past the hour they meant to leave.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} runs the room and not just the bar: the man who has had enough is talked into a plate of food, two strangers are introduced and spend the night buying each other rounds, and a brewer's carter is argued down on price where he stands. By closing the tavern has taken more than it did all weekend.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The client is delighted by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps defuse the violent situation.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} watches helplessly as a disagreement between two drunk mercenaries explodes into a full tavern brawl. Tables shatter, bottles fly, and by the time the city guard arrives, the bar looks like a warzone. {worker_name} catches an elbow to the face trying to intervene too late, and the night's earnings are spent on repairs.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} tries to step between the fighters but gets shoved aside. Eventually talks the less drunk one into backing down, but not before a table and several chairs are destroyed. The other patrons clear out early, killing the evening's revenue.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} reads the tension building between two groups of adventurers and acts before fists fly. Steps in with a firm voice and a free round, redirecting the aggression into a drinking contest instead. The night ends louder than usual, but profitable and with the furniture intact.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} handles the erupting brawl like a veteran peacekeeper. Catches the first thrown punch mid-swing by slamming a mug on the bar so hard the whole room freezes. Talks both sides down with a mix of humor and steel-eyed authority, then sells them twice as much ale as they'd normally drink. The tavern earns more than a usual night, and both groups leave as friends.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps defuse the violent situation.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps navigate the stranger's cryptic requests.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tries to serve the hooded stranger who appeared at closing time, but something about the figure's cold, unblinking stare makes every movement clumsy. The stranger orders a drink that doesn't exist, and when {worker_name} admits ignorance, the figure stands without a word and leaves a single copper coin on the bar - an insult that feels oddly threatening.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} serves the cloaked stranger adequately but can't crack their silence. The figure drinks alone, pays fairly, and vanishes into the night. {worker_name} finds a strange symbol scratched into the bar where they sat, but nothing comes of it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} engages the mysterious traveler with the right balance of curiosity and discretion. Over several drinks, the stranger opens up enough to share tales from distant lands and leaves a generous purse of foreign gold. The stories attract other patrons who stay late to listen.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} recognizes the cloaked figure as someone of real importance - a disguised noble, a wandering archmage, or perhaps something stranger. Through careful conversation and perfect hospitality, {worker_name} earns the stranger's trust and a significant reward, along with a cryptic promise that 'this establishment will be remembered when the time comes.'

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps navigate the stranger's cryptic requests.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the late-night encounter irresistible.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tries to meet the mercenary halfway when the last patron leans over the bar and takes their hand, and gets every part of it slightly wrong. A bottle goes over. The kiss lands at an angle and stays there. By the time the two of them are behind the bar the moment has been finished for several minutes and both of them know it. The mercenary makes an apology out of it and leaves, and {worker_name} mops up alone.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} lets the stranger stay after the bolt goes across. It happens standing, against the stockroom wall between the ale barrels, and it is over faster than either of them planned. Nothing about it is bad. Nothing about it is worth remembering either. A few coins get left on the bar on the way past.

descriptions.success: {worker_name} takes the man's night and hands it back to him properly: flat on the silk, undressed slowly enough to become a problem, and then a pace that has nothing to do with what the gambler asked for and everything to do with what he actually wanted. He gives up trying to steer somewhere in the middle of it. A serious share of the winnings is on the nightstand by morning.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} runs the bath first and takes his time in it, until the man has stopped mentioning the cards entirely. Then the bed, and an hour of being shown precisely what he is not getting yet. When it finally happens it runs until the light comes up; the gambler manages three and cannot explain the third to anybody. He leaves half of what he won and tells the whole floor about it for a week.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The winner can't take his eyes off {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: The winner can't take her eyes off {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} takes the woman up to the VIP suite and spends the hour holding her hair back instead. The winnings were celebrated on the way up the stairs. There is a small tip, an enormous apology, and a walk back down to the floor that feels considerably longer than it is.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} follows the gambler to the private suite, where the woman spends the whole time with half an eye on the bag she carried up with her. Some hurried kissing, some fumbling under the silk, and then it is done. The tip is adequate, which is the word for all of it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} gets the winner onto the bed and undresses in front of her without hurrying, because the watching is half of what she is paying for. Then settles between her thighs and runs the whole thing the way she runs a table: slowly when the woman wants speed, faster the moment she stops asking, holding her just short of it until she gives up and says so. A serious share of the night's take ends up on the nightstand.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} begins in the suite's bath and stays there long enough that the woman forgets she is rich. Leads her to the bed dripping, then makes her watch, and keeps her watching until asking politely is beyond her. What follows takes what is left of the night, hands and mouths changing places until the light comes up, and the winner comes apart three separate times. She leaves half of it behind and tells the floor exactly what the VIP suite costs.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The winner can't take her eyes off {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} can barely concentrate on the cards — every brush of fingers during a deal sends a shiver up their spine.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name}'s hands shake so badly they misdeal three times in a row. The flirting that was meant to smooth things over lands as awkward desperation. A high-roller accuses them of cheating and security has to escort {worker_name} off the floor.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} fumbles through the shift — dealing slow, eyes wandering to every low neckline and tight sleeve at the table. The gamblers notice the distraction and press their advantage. The house edge slips, but not catastrophically.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} turns flustered energy into dangerous charm at the table. The heated glances and lingering card passes keep gamblers off-balance and betting recklessly. The house wins big while the players leave feeling they had the time of their lives.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes the most magnetic presence on the casino floor. Every deal is a seduction, every smile a dare. High-rollers fight for seats at the table, bet wildly to impress, and lose gleefully. The casino's take is enormous and management considers a permanent raise.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns distraction into devastating table charisma.

professions.name: Guard
professions.description: Protects the casino from disruptive patrons and cheaters. Generates money through security services. Prevents losses from troublemakers.

daily_stories.trait_success: The disruptive patron backs down, intimidated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} grabs the man by the collar in full view of three tables and takes an elbow in the mouth for it. The fight goes over a roulette rail before it ends. Two players cash out and leave, and one of them was four hundred up.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} gets him out eventually. It takes ten minutes, two other guards and a raised voice heard across the floor, and the nearest tables stop playing to watch. Order restored, and everybody remembers how.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} reaches him before he reaches the dealer, puts a hand on his shoulder and a quiet word in his ear, and walks him to the door like a friend seeing him home. Nobody at the next table looks up from their cards.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} spots the man an hour before he becomes a problem, has his tab quietly closed, and meets him at the stairs with his coat and a drink for the road. He leaves believing it was his own idea. The pit boss makes a note of who was on the floor tonight.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The disruptive patron backs down, intimidated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: The cheating gambler is caught off-guard by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} fails to catch the cheating gambler in action. The cheater successfully scams the casino out of money while avoiding detection, causing significant financial losses and reputation damage.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} suspects cheating but can't gather enough evidence to act decisively. The gambler gets away with some winnings, though their activities are curtailed and they eventually leave.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} successfully catches the cheating gambler red-handed. Gathers solid evidence, confronts the cheater professionally, and recovers the stolen money while maintaining casino security.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} executes a perfect sting operation against the cheating gambler. Not only catches them in the act but also uncovers their entire scheme, recovering all losses and earning praise from management.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The cheating gambler is caught off-guard by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} is crucial in stopping the heist.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} is caught completely off guard when a coordinated theft hits the casino's chip vault. A distraction at the main floor draws {worker_name} away from their post, and by the time they realize the ruse, the thieves have vanished with a chest of high-value chips. The loss is substantial and {worker_name} takes a beating from the getaway muscle.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} spots the thieves too late - they've already grabbed a handful of chips from behind the exchange counter. Gives chase and manages to tackle one of the three, recovering some of the stolen goods, but the other two escape into the crowd. Better than nothing, but the casino still takes a hit.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} notices the suspicious coordination between three 'patrons' casing the chip vault and acts before they strike. Positions strategically, waits for the attempt, then intercepts the ringleader mid-grab. The other two flee empty-handed when they see their leader pinned. All stolen property is recovered and the would-be thief is handed to the city guard.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} doesn't just stop the theft - they set a trap. After noticing the casing pattern days ago, {worker_name} lets the thieves think they have an opening, then springs the ambush with perfect timing. All three are caught with evidence, the recovered intel reveals planned hits on other establishments, and the city guard pays a bounty for dismantling the ring.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} is crucial in stopping the heist.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} prowls the casino floor coiled tight — every confrontation feels personal, every adrenaline spike doubles.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} overreacts to a minor dispute between card players, slamming a patron against the wall when a firm word would have sufficed. The casino pays damages and {worker_name} works out the shift cooling off in the back room, still vibrating with unspent tension.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} stalks the floor with visible intensity that makes patrons uneasy. A scuffle at the dice tables is handled competently but with excessive force. The troublemaker is removed, but two bystanders also leave, put off by the aggressive energy.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} channels restless energy into an intimidating patrol that keeps every cheat, drunk, and pickpocket on their best behaviour. The coiled tension in {worker_name}'s frame reads as 'don't even think about it.' The floor runs smooth and incident-free.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} radiates such controlled menace that the entire casino falls into line without a single confrontation. Even the regulars known for causing trouble order quietly and cash out on time. Management notes the cleanest shift in weeks, and the dealers tip {worker_name} from their own pockets.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns tension into an impenetrable wall of authority.

professions.name: Manager
professions.description: Helps manage the business operations. Each manager reduces the chance of daily events by 10%, stacking across all your buildings.

daily_stories.trait_success: The casino benefits from {worker_name}'s {trait} management.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} mismanages the casino floor. Table rotations tangle, a payout dispute turns ugly, and both dealers and gamblers end the night fed up.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} keeps the casino's tables staffed and the games honest, but little more. The house takes its usual cut and the night passes without event.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} keeps the gaming floor turning at a steady clip. Dealers rotate on time, disputes are settled quietly, and gamblers keep their coin on the tables.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} reads the floor like a master gambler, moving dealers to hot tables, comping the right high rollers, and spotting a card cheat before he costs the house a coin. The vault is heavy by dawn.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The casino benefits from {worker_name}'s {trait} management.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} secures the deal with the whale.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} botches negotiations with a legendary high roller looking for a new regular casino. Offers terms that are either too stingy or too generous - the whale sees through the amateurish approach and takes their fortune to a rival establishment. The missed revenue is staggering.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} negotiates acceptable terms with the wealthy gambler, but gives away too many concessions - free suites, unlimited drinks, higher table limits. The whale agrees to play regularly, but the margins on their patronage are razor-thin. Better than losing them entirely, but barely.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} strikes a shrewd deal with the mega-gambler. Offers just enough luxury and exclusivity to seal the commitment while protecting the casino's margins. The whale gets their private table, premium service, and modest credit line, while the casino locks in a patron whose losses will far exceed the perks over time.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} plays the negotiation like a master game of cards. Reads the whale's ego perfectly, offering prestige over discounts - a named table, a portrait on the VIP wall, first-name recognition from all staff. The whale is so flattered they accept terms that heavily favor the casino and bring three wealthy friends to the next session. The deal becomes the most profitable patron agreement in the casino's history.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} secures the deal with the whale.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} is so wound up that every decision feels like a gamble — and tonight, the manager keeps doubling down.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} approves a VIP's request to raise the table limit without checking their credit, comps an entire bottle of aged brandy to a stranger who smiles the right way, and forgets to rotate the dealers — the house loses a fortune at one table before anyone notices. The pit boss is livid.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} makes decisions faster than usual, which means some land and some don't. A bold promotion fills the floor but the margins are thin. The staff notice the boss is distracted — fiddling with chips, pacing the pit, staring out at the floor with unfocused eyes.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} channels the reckless energy into aggressive, high-confidence management. VIPs are courted with magnetic intensity, table limits are adjusted with razor intuition, and a suspected card counter is ejected with a smile and a handshake. The house wins big tonight.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} manages the casino like it's a personal conquest. Every gamble pays off — a new high-roller is personally welcomed and loses a small fortune happily, a competing establishment's poaching attempt is countered with a loyalty bonus that costs less than a single bad night, and the floor runs with military precision. Record profits.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns reckless instinct into casino gold.

professions.name: Casino server
professions.description: Serves patrons on the casino floor. Generates income through quick, attentive hospitality. Steady, low-risk work.

daily_stories.trait_success: The client appreciates {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses track of who ordered what somewhere between the card tables and the slots. Drinks land in front of the wrong gamblers mid-hand, a spilled cocktail stains the felt of the high table, and the pit boss spends the night making apologies that come out of the tips.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} keeps the drinks coming at a steady, forgettable pace. Gamblers get their refills without looking up from their hands — which is the problem. Nobody remembers the service, nobody orders past their thirst, and the floor drinks less than it bets.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} learns the floor's rhythm fast — who drinks when they're winning, who drinks when they're losing, who needs coffee before they wager the deed to something. Glasses arrive just as they empty, and the guests play longer because nothing ever interrupts them.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} makes the whole floor feel lucky. The right drink appears at every winning streak like an omen, losers get their consolation poured with enough charm to keep them seated, and the high-rollers start tipping in chips just to keep {worker_name} in orbit. The house wins it all back at the tables, of course.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The client appreciates {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} dropped and shuffled the drink chits mid-shift and had to charm the gamblers while sorting out who ordered what.

descriptions.success: {worker_name} recovered with quick charm and a steady tray, comping the mixed-up drinks before anyone could sour on the table. The gamblers took it for a lucky accident and played on.
descriptions.failure: The confusion reached the tables at the worst moment — a VIP's lucky bourbon went to a stranger mid-streak, and superstition did the rest. The complaints reached the pit boss before the drinks reached anyone.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} straightened out most of the chits between hands, but the delays showed. Gamblers drink on rhythm, and a broken rhythm on a casino floor gets noticed and remembered.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turned the mix-up into a superstition — the house's shuffle, a wrong drink as the omen of a right hand. Half the floor started ordering blind on purpose, and the tips came in chips.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name} leveraged {trait} to calm frustrated customers.
daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name} leveraged {trait} to calm frustrated customers.

daily_stories.trait_success: The VIP is completely captivated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} is sent up to the champagne room with a tray and four VIPs already three bottles into the evening. When a hand goes under her skirt she is out of reach before she has decided to move, and the room turns cold in a second. They ask for a different girl, loudly, and settle the bill without a copper on top. Management hears about it before she is back down the stairs.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} pours for the VIPs and lets their hands go where they are going to go. One pulls her down onto his lap mid-refill; she finishes him under the table when he insists on it, and does not spill anything. It is a job of work and she does it correctly. They tip for the compliance rather than the enthusiasm, and they are right to.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} runs the champagne room instead of serving it. She pours from a VIP's knee, decides who gets her attention and when, and when the richest one finally stops circling she straddles him in the booth and takes her time about it while the rest of the table throws coins at the pair of them. The noise she makes is not for their benefit, which is exactly why it works. Two more want their turn, and she gets through all of them and a small fortune in tips.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turns the champagne room into an auction and puts herself up. She serves the first bottle in a way that makes it clear what is being sold, lets them bid each other up for an hour, and gives the winner a lap dance slow enough to be a cruelty before she sinks onto him in front of the room. Then she works through every man in it who can meet the price, holding the eye of the next one while she finishes the last. By closing she is soaked through, half the aristocracy of this city cannot find its own coats, and there is enough gold on the table to run the house for a week.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The VIP is completely captivated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: The VIP ladies are completely captivated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} carries the tray up to a circle of noblewomen who have been at it since noon. A hand goes under her skirt and she is out of reach before she has thought about it. The temperature drops. They ask for somebody less provincial, settle the bill exactly, and one of them mentions the standard of service downstairs on her way out.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} pours for the ladies and lets their hands wander. One draws her down into her lap between refills; another wants attention under her gown and gets it, briskly and well. Nobody is disappointed and nobody is transported. The tip says as much.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} works the champagne room like a floor she owns. She pours from a noblewoman's knee, takes her time deciding who is interesting, and when the richest of them stops pretending to care about the cards, {worker_name} settles across her lap in the booth and does not hurry any part of it. The rest of the table stops talking. Two more ask for their turn before the bottles are done, and she leaves with more in tips than the floor pays in a month.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} starts a bidding war over herself and then lets it run. She serves the first bottle slowly enough that the ladies forget there is a game downstairs, lets them raise each other for the better part of an hour, and then goes to the winner, kneels, and does not get up again until the woman has lost track of the room entirely. After that she works her way round the table. By closing, the best names in the city are in no condition to find their own carriages, and the tips alone come to more than the tables took all evening.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The VIP ladies are completely captivated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} delivers drinks with trembling hands and eyes that linger too long on the high-rollers' table.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} spills champagne down a VIP's silk sleeve while staring at the dealer's forearms. The fumbled apology involves too much touching, the VIP's companion takes offense, and security escorts {worker_name} off the floor. The table cashes out early.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} delivers the right drinks to the wrong tables twice, too busy scanning the room for attractive faces to check the order slips. Service is slow and distracted — the gamblers notice but don't complain because the flushed, breathless energy is at least entertaining.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} turns the flush and trembling into an alluring vulnerability that high-rollers eat up. The slightly breathless delivery, the lingering eye contact over the cocktail glass, the 'accidental' brush of fingers — players feel lucky just being served and bet bigger to keep the attention coming.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes the most requested server on the floor. The heated energy is magnetic — VIPs wave {worker_name} over just to watch the flustered smile, and they tip in gold chips to keep the visits coming. The floor boss notices that every table {worker_name} serves runs hotter and longer. A permanent VIP section assignment is discussed.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns nervous energy into VIP magnetism.

professions.name: Rest
professions.description: Worker takes a break to regenerate health and energy. No daily events occur, allowing recovery without risk.

daily_stories.description: The dealer takes a break, stepping away from the tables to recharge.

{worker_name} locks the upstairs staff room on the rest day and masturbates with a hand over their own mouth, mindful of thin walls. The climax leaves them composed enough to face the floor again with a straight face.

building_types.name: Castle
building_types.skill_description: Exquisite furnishings, rare wines, and opulent decorations that impress the aristocracy. Enhanced luxury helps your courtiers handle demanding nobles and create unforgettable experiences. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

professions.name: Ambassador
professions.description: Conducts diplomatic missions and negotiates agreements. Generates reputation and money through political work. Builds alliances and resolves conflicts.

daily_stories.trait_success: The trade delegation is impressed by {worker_name}'s {trait} during negotiations.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} sits down opposite merchants who have done this for thirty years and shows them every card by the second course. The agreement that emerges taxes the castle's goods coming and going, and the other delegation signs it quickly, before anyone can read it twice.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} brings home a workable agreement — grain moves, tariffs hold, nobody is insulted. But the exclusive clauses went unclaimed, and the other party's smiles at the signing suggest they know exactly what they didn't have to give up.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} negotiates like someone who read the other side's ledgers first. Every concession is traded for two, the tariff schedule lands in the castle's favor, and the foreign merchants leave believing the terms were their own idea — the mark of a deal that will hold.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} walks out with terms the castle's own clerks double-check in disbelief: exclusive rights on the river trade, tariffs fixed for a decade, and a partner kingdom convinced it owes the castle a favor besides. Merchant houses start sending envoys before the ink dries.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The trade delegation is impressed by {worker_name}'s {trait} during negotiations.

daily_stories.trait_success: The foreign delegation is won over by {worker_name}'s {trait} during the alliance talks.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} misreads the delegation from the first toast — the wrong noble seated below the salt, a border grievance raised as small talk. The envoys withdraw behind flawless courtesies, and the report they carry home paints the castle as clumsy and the alliance as unnecessary.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} keeps the talks warm from the first course to the last toast, but warm is all they get. The delegation departs with gifts, compliments, and no signature — a friendship declared, an alliance postponed.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} finds the thing the foreign kingdom actually wants — not the trade terms they argued over, but the assurance underneath them — and builds the treaty around it. The seals go on before witnesses, and the castle's name is spoken differently in that court from now on.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} forges the kind of alliance other courts convene councils to discuss. Mutual defense, favored trade, a foreign prince's standing invitation — all arranged so gracefully that both sides claim the credit. The castle now has a powerful friend and, more useful still, a reputation for making them.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The foreign delegation is won over by {worker_name}'s {trait} during the alliance talks.

daily_stories.trait_success: The conflicting parties are persuaded by {worker_name}'s {trait} mediation.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tries to mediate between the feuding houses and manages to unite them in one thing only: irritation with the castle. A misjudged compromise reads as favoritism, an old insult resurfaces at the table, and the dispute leaves the room larger than it entered.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} talks the feuding nobles down from open threats to a sullen truce. Nobody withdraws a claim and nobody draws steel — the quarrel is not resolved so much as adjourned, and everyone at court knows the session will reconvene.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} takes the feud apart the way a clockmaker takes apart a jammed clock — finding the actual grievance beneath the stated ones. The settlement gives each house something it can call a victory, and the castle quietly collects a reputation as the place where quarrels go to end.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} not only ends the feud but leaves the two houses bound by a betrothal, a shared border commission, and a genuine, slightly bewildered respect for the mediator who managed it. Nobles with grievances now request the castle's arbitration by name — an influence no army could purchase.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The conflicting parties are persuaded by {worker_name}'s {trait} mediation.

daily_stories.trait_success: The cultural delegation is inspired by {worker_name}'s {trait} during the exchange.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} plans the exchange around what the castle finds impressive rather than what the guests find respectful. A recital runs long, a translated toast lands as an insult, and the visiting delegation spends the final evening being politely, pointedly tired.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} hosts a pleasant week of music and shared meals that everyone enjoys and no one remembers. The guests leave with favorable impressions and empty hands — goodwill established, nothing built on it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} pairs the visiting scholars with the castle's own, sets the musicians of both courts to stealing each other's melodies, and lets the exchange do its real work at the dinner tables. The delegation leaves with copied manuscripts, standing invitations, and reasons to return.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} orchestrates an exchange that outgrows its diplomacy — a joint archive, apprenticeships crossing both borders, a suite composed for the closing night that both courts now claim as their own. Within the season, kingdoms that ignored the castle are asking to attend the next one.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The cultural delegation is inspired by {worker_name}'s {trait} during the exchange.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} enters negotiations flushed and distracted — every delegate's perfume, every accidental touch under the table, is agony.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} can't focus through the haze of want. Fumbles a key treaty clause while staring at the foreign envoy's collarbone, agrees to unfavourable terms without reading them, and the delegation leaves with the better deal and a knowing smirk.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} holds the meeting together by sheer willpower, but the distraction shows in soft concessions and agreements reached too quickly. The deal is done — functional but lopsided. At least nobody noticed the trembling hands.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} weaponises the tension. The flushed cheeks and intent gaze read as passion for the alliance, and the foreign delegate responds to the magnetic energy by becoming surprisingly cooperative. Terms swing favourably and both sides leave satisfied.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} turns smouldering distraction into the most seductive diplomacy the court has ever witnessed. Every loaded pause, every 'accidental' touch during the document signing, every whispered aside — the foreign delegation is utterly charmed. They concede points they'd normally die on, convinced they're forging a deeply personal alliance.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns desperate distraction into irresistible diplomacy.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} made the loss of focus impossible to hide.

professions.name: Courtesan
professions.description: Provides high-class entertainment to noble guests. Generates significant money and reputation through elite services. Requires exceptional charm and sophistication.

daily_stories.trait_success: The noble is captivated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} uses the wrong title twice, then tries to correct it, which makes it worse. The noble's replies get shorter, the wine goes untouched, and they excuse themselves before the second course. A steward makes a note of which courtesan was assigned.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} keeps the conversation going all evening without once letting it become interesting. Weather, roads, the harvest. The noble is neither offended nor engaged, thanks the house on the way out, and asks for someone else next time without saying why.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} works out inside ten minutes that the noble would rather discuss horses than politics, and spends the evening losing an argument about bloodlines on purpose. The noble talks more than they have in months, stays two hours past the arrangement, and asks when {worker_name} is next free.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} draws out a story the noble has plainly never told anyone in this castle — something about a brother, and a debt — and then never refers to it again. The noble leaves feeling listened to rather than entertained, which is rarer and costs more. Two invitations arrive within the week, both naming {worker_name}.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The noble is captivated by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: The diplomatic guests are impressed by {worker_name}'s {trait} at the soiree.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} repeats a joke from one delegation in front of another, and the room hears exactly how it lands. Two ambassadors stop speaking to each other for the rest of the evening. The governor's secretary spends the next morning writing letters about it.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} circulates, says the correct things, and is remembered by nobody. The soiree ends without incident and without advantage: the castle's guest list looks precisely the same in the morning as it did the night before.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} spends the evening moving people rather than talking to them — steering a grain envoy toward the harbour master, keeping two rival houses at opposite ends of the room, filling a silence before anyone notices it was there. Three conversations happen that the castle wanted to happen.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} identifies which delegation is actually holding up the trade objection, then arranges for its second secretary to be seated beside the one noble who can overrule them. By dessert the objection has quietly gone away. No record shows that {worker_name} did anything, which is the point, and the governor notices anyway.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The diplomatic guests are impressed by {worker_name}'s {trait} at the soiree.

daily_stories.trait_success: The aristocratic patron is overwhelmed by {worker_name}'s {trait} during the intimate encounter.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} pushes where the patron wanted to be drawn out, and she notices. What was meant to look like appetite looks like a schedule. She lets him finish the wine, declines the rest of the evening, and does not ask for him again.
